landing.beat1.t: Your result stays behind your own screen
landing.beat1.d: Nothing reaches a partner, a relative or a counsellor until you agree, and you can stop sharing in one tap.
landing.beat2.t: Every family is a tree. In some, branches meet.
landing.beat2.d: When partners are related, they can share a change passed down from the same grandparents. KinSight shows how, without blame.
landing.beat3.t: That becomes a chance, not a verdict
landing.beat3.d: If both partners carry a change in the same gene, each pregnancy has a 1 in 4 chance that the child has the condition: 25 out of 100. An estimate, not a diagnosis.

landing.statement: Being a carrier is not the same as having a condition. A result is information, and every choice stays yours.

landing.close.d: The guided demo plays every feature with fictional people, in English or Arabic. Nothing real is used.

demo.intro.title: Welcome to KinSight
demo.intro.text: KinSight helps a couple understand an inherited-health screening result in plain words, with a human counsellor in the loop. Everything you will see is fictional.
demo.how.title: From result to the right next step
demo.how.text: Five stages: the result arrives, you understand it, a counsellor reviews anything complex, you see your options with owners and dates, and you decide what to share with family.
demo.cases.title: Seven fictional cases
demo.cases.text: These cases are computed by the real engine: unrelated or related couples, one or two carriers, an unclear result, an X-linked change. Each shows how the same product responds to a different situation.
demo.roles.title: Seven roles, one product
demo.roles.text: Two partners, a relative, a counsellor, an analyst, an auditor and a demo operator. Each role sees only what the privacy rules allow, and the side menu changes with the role.
demo.topbar.title: Language and reading level
demo.topbar.text: Switch between English and Arabic, and between simple and standard wording. Explanations are pre-written at both levels, so nothing is invented on the fly.
demo.learn-inherit.title: Learn: how inheritance works
demo.learn-inherit.text: When both parents carry one changed copy of a gene, each pregnancy has three possible outcomes. This standard teaching diagram makes the one-in-four idea visible.
demo.learn-chance.title: What a chance looks like
demo.learn-chance.text: Numbers are hard, so chances are also drawn as people out of one hundred. Below one percent, nobody is highlighted and we say so instead of rounding up.
demo.learn-glossary.title: Myths, facts and a plain glossary
demo.learn-glossary.text: Common worries are answered calmly, and a searchable glossary explains every term. Nobody is blamed and nothing here tells a couple what to decide.
demo.palette.title: Search everything
demo.palette.text: Press Control and K anywhere to jump to a page, a glossary term or a demo case. It works by keyboard alone.
demo.result.title: My result, in neutral words
demo.result.text: Person A sees what was found for them. The words are found and not found, and the colours are calm because a result is information, not a verdict.
demo.explain.title: A verified explanation
demo.explain.text: The explanation uses pre-approved sentences. The numbers come from the engine and a verifier checks every digit before anyone sees it. Read aloud is there for people who prefer to listen.
demo.pool-a.title: The couple view needs both partners
demo.pool-a.text: A couple figure uses both partners' results, so it exists only after both agree. Person A agrees now. Until the partner also agrees, nothing is shown and neither partner is told why.
demo.pool-b.title: The partner agrees; a counsellor reviews
demo.pool-b.text: Person B agrees too. Because this case is tier three, the figure stays hidden until a qualified counsellor has reviewed it with the couple.
demo.counsellor.title: The counsellor's console
demo.counsellor.text: The counsellor sees only assigned cases and only what each person consented to share. Workload counts show what is open, waiting and overdue.
demo.queue.title: A queue that can be filtered
demo.queue.text: Twenty-seven sample cases from the demo cohort, sorted by tier and due date. Filter by tier, status or overdue, or search by case number.
demo.approve.title: Brief, then a human decision
demo.approve.text: The brief lists findings and flags, each tied to a field of the assessment. The counsellor approves, edits or holds. Approving releases the result to the couple.
demo.close-needs-evidence.title: A case cannot close without evidence
demo.close-needs-evidence.text: Closing is refused unless there is recorded evidence or a counsellor decision. Every referral step has an owner and a due date, and nothing disappears silently.
demo.released.title: Released: the couple view
demo.released.text: Now the couple sees the chance per pregnancy, drawn as people out of a hundred, with the inheritance diagram and a plain note that being related can raise the chance. It is an estimate, not a diagnosis.
demo.quiz-wrong.title: A short check, never a test
demo.quiz-wrong.text: Five questions check understanding. We answer one wrongly on purpose. The response is a gentler re-explanation, never a score shown as failure.
demo.quiz-right.title: Second try, and it never loops
demo.quiz-right.text: After one re-explanation the couple answers again and passes. A second failure would offer a counsellor conversation instead of looping a third time.
demo.journey.title: The path from result to care
demo.journey.text: Counselling, confirmatory testing, specialist referral, closure. Options are listed with equal weight and reflective questions are never scored. What to do next is always the couple's choice.
demo.access.title: Finding services, without naming any
demo.access.text: Generic service types only, in equal weight. A hand-off records a request but names no clinic and never claims availability.
demo.summary.title: A one-page take-home summary
demo.summary.text: What was found, what it means, questions worth asking and the options, on one printable page for the counsellor visit.
demo.family.title: The family circle
demo.family.text: A pedigree in standard symbols; the double line marks a related couple. A relative appears only as a relationship until they accept an invitation, and declining reveals nothing.
demo.toolkit.title: Starting the family conversation
demo.toolkit.text: Studies show relatives are often never told. Gentle conversation starters and a shareable card help, and the card never contains a result or a name.
demo.consents.title: Consent centre: stop sharing in one tap
demo.consents.text: Every agreement is listed with who, why and until when. Watch: revoking the couple agreement takes effect on the very next request.
demo.revoked.title: Revocation is immediate
demo.revoked.text: The couple view is closed again: the figure is gone and the page asks for agreement afresh. Nothing cached remains visible.
demo.privacy.title: Privacy centre: who can see what
demo.privacy.text: A matrix of roles against information. The default is no, there is no export, and nothing is used for employment, insurance or commercial purposes.
demo.accesslog.title: Who looked at your information
demo.accesslog.text: Every access and every refusal is recorded without the content. You can also delete your data entirely.
demo.kin-open.title: Kin, the assistant
demo.kin-open.text: Kin answers questions about your own result by typing or by voice. Watch a question being asked.
demo.kin-refuse.title: Kin declines what it must
demo.kin-refuse.text: Questions about other people, decisions or medical advice are politely declined, and attempts to change its rules fail. It never tells a couple what to decide.
demo.kin-arabic.title: Multilingual, with voice
demo.kin-arabic.text: Ask in Arabic and Kin answers in Arabic, right to left. The microphone uses the browser's own speech recognition and replies can be read aloud; if a device lacks a voice, Kin says so and shows text.
demo.settings.title: Comfort and accessibility
demo.settings.text: Dark mode, three text sizes, high contrast and reduced motion are one click away. The whole product keeps working by keyboard.
demo.arabic.title: Arabic, laid out right to left
demo.arabic.text: Switching to Arabic mirrors the whole layout: the menu moves to the right and icons that imply direction flip. The family diagram keeps its drawing direction.
demo.analyst.title: The analyst sees only anonymous totals
demo.analyst.text: Counts below ten are hidden, noise is added from a privacy budget, and nothing at person level is ever shown. Couples are grouped by support level.
demo.burden.title: Carriers by condition
demo.burden.text: Thirty fictional conditions drawn from the demo cohort. The eye icon marks a hidden small group.
demo.weekly.title: Time to care
demo.weekly.text: Median waiting days from result to counsellor contact, by week. This is an illustrative simulation with stated assumptions, not a forecast.
demo.equity.title: Equity across languages and literacy
demo.equity.text: Quiz pass rates by language, reading level and age band, with a ten-point gap target. These are scripted test inputs that exercise the pipeline, not evidence about people.
demo.capacity.title: Capacity simulator
demo.capacity.text: Slide the number of counsellor slots to see waiting times under three policies. Prioritising by tier, and handling tier one automatically, shortens waits for those who need a counsellor most.
demo.governance.title: An audit trail that detects tampering
demo.governance.text: Every decision is chained with a hash. Verify the chain, then run the tamper test and watch it fail, proving that altering history is detectable.
demo.methods.title: Methods and evidence
demo.methods.text: Every formula is shown, with the kinship values the engine must pass and the review status. The textbook formulas are unreviewed clinically, and the page says so.
demo.outro.title: That is KinSight
demo.outro.text: Deterministic numbers, approved wording, consent on every read, a human in the loop, and a path from result to care. All fictional, all running offline.
methods.pipe.0.d: Each partner's status per condition: found, not found, or not clear.
methods.pipe.1.d: Computes kinship, per-pregnancy chances and the counselling tier. No network, no model, no randomness.
methods.pipe.2.d: A renderer fills reviewed template sentences with the engine's numbers. Nothing is written freely.
methods.pipe.3.d: Allowed blocks, mandatory blocks, numbers equal the engine's, no stray digits, banned phrases, readability, and a rewrite check when enabled.
methods.pipe.4.d: Tier 3 results wait for a qualified counsellor before they are released as final.
methods.formula.ar_both_carrier: Both partners carry the same recessive change.
methods.formula.ar_one_carrier_residual: One carrier. The other partner's chance of still carrying it, given that no change was found, using relatedness r = 2φ, carrier frequency c and test sensitivity s.
methods.formula.ar_both_not_detected: Nothing found in either. Assumes independence, so relatedness can raise the true figure; the text says so.
methods.formula.kinship: General kinship recursion, memoised, handles complex pedigrees.
scen.s1.title: Not related, nothing found
scen.s1.blurb: A couple who are not related. No changes were found in either partner.
scen.s2.title: Not related, one partner carries a change
scen.s2.blurb: One partner carries a change in a gene linked to one condition. The other partner has none found.
scen.s3.title: First cousins, both carry the same change
scen.s3.blurb: First cousins who both carry a change in the same gene. A counsellor reviews this together with them.
scen.s4.title: First cousins, one partner carries a change
scen.s4.blurb: First cousins where one partner carries a change. Being related can raise the chance a little.
scen.s5.title: A result that is not clear
scen.s5.blurb: One test came back unclear. No chance can be given until a counsellor helps work out the next step.
scen.s6.title: X-linked change in the mother
scen.s6.blurb: The mother carries a change on the X chromosome. Sons and daughters are affected differently.
scen.s7.title: Second cousins, nothing found
scen.s7.blurb: Second cousins with no changes found. The estimate says relatedness can raise the true chance a little.
